from: Loop City live v13 · the base for the tensor field
reads_as: incubator/tensor-studio: window.__TENSOR_SITE_INPUT__ = { ring, features, elevation, lang, close, fail }, then buildTensorSite({ ...features, ring, elevation, wind, clip, keepBuildings })
crs: ring and features: WGS84 longitude, latitude (as the tensor app reads them); bng: the same in British National Grid metres (EPSG:27700)
notes: Roads: cls is the OpenMapTiles class the tensor app reads (wool M trunk, A primary, B secondary, C tertiary; existing M motorway); wool says where each came from.
The short "junction" roads cross the site edge at the wool junctions, so the tensor app anchors its main streets there.

From the wool bands page: M is the boundary highway (the cell edge, 90 m), A the primary road (60 m), B the A road (48 m), C the B road (24 to 30 m); the existing roads are among them, each with its class.
Parks: features.parks and bng.parks list the parks taken with the parcels. A park stays a park: the tensor field must not run on it. The site ring is the urban parcels only.
No elevation or buildings in this file: the site data has none at this scale. The tensor app takes its own terrain, or runs flat.
run and cell_keys say which century of step 1 the parcels come from. Only cells of one run fit together: sites with different run.id must not be joined.
